findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Central Zona 1" above "CUADERNOS CRAYONES MOCHILAS TÉMPERAS FOL"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "Librería Aurora", "Cuaderno cosido ×4", "Q85.00", "Colores 24"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "01"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 7 gradient fill(s): div.hero__glow → radial-gradient(40% 50% at 25% 40%, rgb(58, 42, 155) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(35% 40% at 80% | div.page__ruled → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 54.5449px, rgba(255, 65, 48, 0.55) 54.5449px, rgba(255, 65, 48, 0.55)  | div.page__ruled.page__ruled--left → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) calc(100% - 54.5449px), rgba(255, 65, 48, 0.55) calc(100% - 54.5449px)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 23 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.a-btn.a-btn--go → rgb(18, 14, 46) 0px 6px 0px 0px | a.a-btn.a-btn--light → rgb(255, 65, 48) 0px 6px 0px 0px | div.ribbon.ribbon--a → rgb(18, 14, 46) 0px 12px 0px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 2 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fff3dc, section #fff3dc, section #fffaf0).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Bricolage Grotesque Variable, Caveat, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (3.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 104 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 556px at 11304px; 756px at 12212px; 412px at 13532px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "5 pasillos en cada tienda, des" (3px from the left); "Grafito HB y 2B, colores de 12" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 7 different lines (1025px, 3px, 43px, 671px, 1174px, 757px, 1047px); the three most used hold only 57% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Aurora" (screen 7, 100% hidden); "Llega a clases" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "15%" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "FORRAMOS TUS CUADERNOS" (screen 2, 88% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Large text is cut off along its top by the box that holds it: "SACAPUNTAS" (screen 1); "CUADERNOS" (screen 1); "TE ARMAMOS LA LISTA DEL COLEGIO" (screen 1)
findings.fix: Jurors read a wordmark sliced at the top as broken. Give the box room for the ascenders (line-height and padding), or crop at the bottom or a side edge on purpose.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "¿Traes tu lista?" (screen 6, 100% over a picture); "Aurora" (screen 7, 100% over a picture); "Así te armamos la lista" (screen 7, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 4 screens in a row: "El cuaderno de Aurora"; "¿Traes tu lista?"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "REGRESO A CLASES ✦ CUPÓN EN LÍNEA ✦ UNO POR PERS" → 5 lines (13 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Floating rounded pill navigation.
findings.fix: Use a plain bar: wordmark left, a few links, one action.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The margins differ: 18px on the left, 0px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
